title: SPARK Provenance Surface
subtitle: Weighted lexicon, trusted refs, and motion-ready context
summary: Messages are shaped before HiRAG ingest so the same semantic bundle can drive living docs, motion clips, and Hyperdimensions overlays without copy drift.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Accepted content retains favorite words, weighted lexicon, and lineage so the artifact can be reviewed visually before it becomes a clip, a notebook block, or a geometry annotation.

sections.heading: Operator Note
sections.body: Use /render/provenance when the document itself is part of the artifact and text fit matters as much as the rendered motion.
